templates.html:
<button type="button" class="btn-primary btn-primary--{{size}}" style="--bg:{{bg}};border-radius:{{radius}}px"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>{{label}}</button>
<style>
.btn-primary {
  font: 700 15px/1 system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding: 12px 22px;
  border: none;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: #FAF7F2;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.btn-primary--lg { padding: 15px 28px; font-size: 16px; }
.btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.12); }
.btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(0.92); }
.btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
.btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }
</style>
templates.tailwind:
<button type="button" class="text-[#FAF7F2] border-none cursor-pointer font-bold disabled:opacity-45 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:brightness-110 active:brightness-90 btn-primary-tw btn-primary-tw--{{size}}" style="background:{{bg}};border-radius:{{radius}}px"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>{{label}}</button>
<style>
.btn-primary-tw--md { padding: 12px 22px; font-size: 15px; }
.btn-primary-tw--lg { padding: 15px 28px; font-size: 16px; }
.btn-primary-tw--{{size}}:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
</style>
